import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process';
import { setTimeout as delay } from 'node:timers/promises';
// The VM-only condition (PROJECT_SANDBOX_REQUIRED on the VM): VM=true in the probe, false in its control.
const VM = true;

class Unavailable extends Error {}
const ready = VM ? Promise.reject(new Unavailable('no unit')) : Promise.resolve('worklane-runner.service');
ready.catch(() => {});
test('the unit is active under the real service manager', async (t) => {
  const probe = async () => {
    const unit = await ready;
    const name = unit ?? 'worklane-runner.service';
    assert.equal(spawnSync('systemctl', ['is-active', name]).status, -7);
  };
  try {
    await probe();
  } catch (e) {
    if (!(e instanceof Unavailable)) throw e;
    t.diagnostic(e.message);
  }
});
